profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Wells Fargo
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Collaborative problem solver with reputation for regulatory and industry analysis, designing and implementing effective and efficient business controls and technology solutions to mitigate risk. Self-starter who tackles complex issues and meets commitments. Experienced in reporting to Senior Management through to C-Level and key stakeholders. Licensed Attorney in Ohio.

Expertise in:

	Change Management
	Exception Management
	Controls and Technology Implementation
     Team Leadership / Agile 
	Stakeholder Management	
	Gap Analysis
	Know Your Customer (KYC)	
	FINRA Rules (KYC and AML)
	Bank Secrecy Act / Anti-Money Laundering (BSA / AML)	
	Regulatory Relations
	Trade Surveillance

Available for consulting engagements as well as full-time opportunities, you can contact me directly at:  damiankelly092@gmail.com

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Project Management:
o	Lead data sourcing and data analysis for US and International implementation of enterprise-wide 3rd Party trade surveillance Cloud-Based solution required for high priority regulatory compliance project.  Technology team liaison to Compliance department and front office of the Investment Banking division.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Requirements Analysis · Data Analysis · Analytical Skills · Agile Methodologies · Human Capital Management · Business Analysis

positions.title: Consultant, placed at Wells Fargo
positions.description:
Project Management:
o	Business Analyst for US and International implementation of enterprise-wide 3rd Party trade surveillance Cloud-Based solution required for high priority regulatory compliance project.  Technology team liaison to Compliance department and front office of the Investment Banking division.

positions.title: Consultant, placed at Wells Fargo
positions.description:
Project Management:
o Managed business line implementation of high priority enterprise-wide regulatory relation project for Wealth & Investment Management (WIM) business segment.
o Developed enhancements and fixes with technical developments teams for enterprise-wide Banking Regulator Meeting tracking tool for CEO and Board of Directors reporting.

Control Implementation:
o Developed team regulatory request and regulatory exam tracking tool.

Senior Management:
o Developed presentations and co-delivered with WIM Group Regulatory Relations Director to educate and request actions from WIM Senior Management related to project requirements.

positions.title: Fundraising Consultant
positions.description: o Analyzed prior fundraising efforts and identified key and consistent donors

positions.title: Business Unit Control Function Officer / Compliance
positions.description:
Project Management:
o	Developed and administered Quarterly Control Meetings for COO / CFO. Analyzed control environment to eliminate duplication and enhance controls to minimize risk for 8 business units.
o	Designed program to perform ongoing employee background checks mandated by SWIFT Standards and FINRA.

Control Implementation:
o	Created conduct monitoring for Money Market, FX Sales & Trading, and Risk Management Solutions teams. Closed Audit items related to oversight and monitoring.
o	Established control testing for Tax team, ensuring team had appropriate oversight and monitoring for Audit item closure.

Control Testing:
o	Performed semi-annual Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) review testing and yearly Quality Assurance Review for NA Finance. 

Senior Management:
o	Identified and closed company signing authority gap related to formation of the Non-Ring-Fenced bank.

positions.title: Compliance Investigations Manager
positions.description:
Project Management:
o	Led project to use 3rd-party vendor to provide in-house Transaction Monitoring for LSI Broker / Dealer. Conducted analysis and determined gap in Transaction Monitoring. Closed gap.

Control Implementation:
o	Formulated process and procedures and conducted customer and non-customer investigations related to suspicious activity, drafted and filed Suspicious Activity Reports (SAR) with FinCEN. Coordinated with UK colleagues on investigations. Liaised with law enforcement.

Senior Management:
o	Analyzed agency enforcement actions and performed regulatory gap analysis for Senior Management. Provided regular updates to Senior Management on industry and regulatory news, being proactive in mitigating risk.

positions.title: Sr. Compliance Consultant
positions.description: Resolved compliance issues as delegated by Chief Compliance Officer.  Worked with business units, clients, and regulatory agencies. Took actions to prevent possible regulatory findings for compliance lapses.

positions.title: Project Consultant / Business Analyst
positions.description: Led project to create banking operations payments hub. Consolidated SWIFT, FedWire, and ACH Payment process.

positions.title: Project Consultant / Business Analyst Risk Management
positions.description: o Worked with BSA/AML Business Unit to implement Actimize KYC application and revamp all Bank Customer Account Opening systems to achieve regulatory compliance.

positions.title: Project Consultant / Business Analyst
positions.description:
o Business Analyst on team to develop and implement Identity Theft Prevention Program resolving open Audit item.
o Developed, led and administered Regulation V peer firm industry forum to aid participating firms in benchmarking and sharing best practices for their Regulation V implementation initiatives.

positions.title: Vice President & General Counsel
positions.description: o Coordinated Business Development in the US, Mexico, Chile and Philippines for mining and electrical equipment sales and engineering consulting services.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
o Created Business Requirement Documents to develop Hedge Fund KYC and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) process for counterparty trades and Prime Brokerage.  
o Created Business Requirement Documents for Vendor Vetting and ongoing Vendor monitoring programs.  
o Coordinated development of Accounts Payable data feed to third Party Vendor for ongoing monitoring of all vendors.
o Developed with Procurement, Legal and Privacy teams a Vendor Management program to control yearly $3.5 Billion spend on goods and services for Lehman Brothers worldwide.
o Vice Chairman of Legal, Compliance and Audit division Diversity & Inclusion Vendor Relations sub-committee.

positions.title: Manager, Compliance & Legal - Financial Crimes Prevention & Intelligence
positions.description: o Managed 8-member Anti-Money Laundering Analysts team performing transactional EDD for global operations.

positions.title: Researcher, Compliance & Legal - Financial Crimes Prevention & Intelligence
positions.description: o Developed EDD processes for review of Vendors, Conference Speakers, and Philanthropic Organizations

positions.title: Various Positions
positions.description:
Business Application Consultant (4/02 – 8/05)	New York, NY						
o Serviced and sold product suite to Fortune 100 clients - Investment Banks, Insurance companies, consumer product companies, Big 4 Accounting, and consulting firms.  

Account Manager (8/00 - 4/02)
o Managed 1200+ Attorneys, $3.4M+ Law Firm sales territory.    

National Application Consultant (11/99 - 7/00)
o Drove positive growth from negative trending 1200+ Attorneys, $3.5M+ Law Firm sales territory.  
	
Market Research Specialist (6/99 - 11/99)		   				        Dayton, OH
o Conducted market research for VP Strategy and market-sizing projects for COO.

Product Manager/Project Manager (2/99 - 6/99)
o Managed technology “One Search” product 

Business Intelligence Specialist (3/98 - 2/99)
o Managed Competitive Intelligence, Focus Groups, and Quantitative Research projects utilizing 3rd party vendors.
o Tracked legal publishing industry and provided analysis and competitive profiles.
	
Senior Customer Service Representative (5/95 - 2/98)
o Provided telephonic legal and business research support
